observations: TV screen displaying the PlayStation 4 user interface.
Library menu in photo 0 shows 'All 15' items, including titles like Call of Duty, Days Gone, and God of War.
An icon for 'EA SPORTS FC 26' is visible in photos 0 and 1; this is a non-existent title as of the current date.
All game icons in the library and home screen feature a 'lock' symbol, indicating they are currently inaccessible.
System notifications in photos 1 and 2 reference '.pkg' files (e.g., 'DAYSGONE.pkg'), which are typically associated with package installers on modified/jailbroken firmware.
A watermark 'JAYCYPHER GAMES' is overlaid on the screen images.
There are no photos of the physical console, cables, or controllers.

claims.evidence: No photos of the hardware were provided to confirm the three-tier 'Pro' chassis or model number.
While 15 items are in the library, they all show lock icons and may not be playable without a specific account or jailbreak state.

risks.risk: The console may not be the 'Pro' model claimed.
risks.proof: A photo of the console hardware showing the three-layer design and the model sticker (CUH-7xxx).

risks.risk: The games may be unplayable digital placeholders or require a jailbreak to run.
risks.proof: A video showing the console booting and successfully launching one of the listed games.

risks.risk: Condition and presence of controllers is unknown.
risks.proof: Photos of the front and back of the included controllers.

risks.risk: The 'FC 26' icon suggests modified or fraudulent software assets.
risks.proof: A photo of the 'System Information' screen showing the software version.
risks.if_unproven: as a standard console with locked/inaccessible content

proof_requests: Photos of the actual PS4 console and the controllers.
A photo of the model number sticker on the back or bottom of the console.
A video of the console running and a game being played to verify the 'lock' icons are resolved.
A photo of the 'System Information' screen in settings.
response.reason: The seller has only provided photos of a TV screen and none of the actual hardware. The presence of an impossible game title (FC 26) and lock icons on all games makes the software and hardware status highly uncertain.
